title: Troubleshooting Microsoft Entra Connect Cloud Sync — Users Skipped / Not Provisioned to Entra (JoinNotFound, Scoping, Config & Quarantine)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 — diagnostics toolkit for a specific, high-frequency cloud sync failure (users skipped / JoinNotFound / not provisioned).
Distinct from the Hybrid Identity (Connect Sync) and Source Anchor products — this is Entra Connect CLOUD SYNC (lightweight agent) provisioning troubleshooting.
AADCloudSyncTools + Graph provisioning logs; read-only diagnostics.
